LanguageData.PositioningEnabledExplained: Enable Achtung's right-click positioning, dragging, and formation controls.
LanguageData.AchtungModifierExplained: Hold this key while positioning to draft the selected colonists. They keep their current formation while you drag with the right mouse button. You can release the key once the right mouse button is held. Rotate the formation with Q and E.
LanguageData.CommandMenuModeOptionAutoExplained: Use the colonist's draft status to choose between the context menu and positioning.
LanguageData.CommandMenuModeOptionPressForMenuExplain: Hold the key to open the context menu instead of performing the default action.
LanguageData.CommandMenuModeOptionPressForPositionExp: Hold the key to position colonists instead of opening the context menu.
LanguageData.CommandMenuModeOptionDelayedExplained: Right-click to position; hold the button for the set delay to open the context menu.
LanguageData.DelayExplained: How long, in milliseconds, to hold right-click before the context menu opens.
LanguageData.DraftedColonistDraggingModeExplained: Choose when right-clicking a drafted colonist starts dragging or formation positioning.
LanguageData.DraftedColonistDraggingModeOptionOffExpl: Right-clicking drafted colonists does not start dragging.
LanguageData.DraftedColonistDraggingModeOptionUnselec: Start dragging only if no orderable colonist was selected before the right-click.
LanguageData.DraftedColonistDraggingModeOptionAlwaysE: Right-clicking a drafted colonist always enables dragging or formation positioning.
LanguageData.RescueEnabledTitle: Rescue column on the Work tab
LanguageData.RescueEnabledExplained: Add a Rescue work priority so colonists automatically carry downed allies to beds.
LanguageData.ShowForceEndLetterExplained: Show a letter when a colonist has no forced work left.
LanguageData.KeepDraftedAndUndraftedCommandsSeparateE: Keep right-click commands for drafted and undrafted colonists separate, as in unmodded RimWorld.
LanguageData.ReplaceCleanRoomExplained: Use Achtung's thorough room-cleaning command instead of RimWorld's command.
LanguageData.ReplaceFightFireExplained: Use Achtung's thorough firefighting command instead of RimWorld's command.
LanguageData.ForcedCommandState: Ordered to keep working until done.
LanguageData.IncreaseForceRadiusDesc: Increase the search radius for forced work (currently {0}).
LanguageData.DecreaseForceRadiusDesc: Decrease the search radius for forced work (currently {0}).
LanguageData.BuildingSmartDesc: Avoids unreachable gaps and trapped builders. It is slower and builds outward from the starting point.
LanguageData.BreakLevelExplained: Stop forced work when the colonist reaches this level of mental-break risk.
LanguageData.HealthLevelExplained: Stop forced work when the colonist reaches this health condition.
LanguageData.IgnoreForbiddenExplained: Allow forced work on forbidden items.
LanguageData.IgnoreRestrictionsExplained: Allow forced work outside a colonist's allowed area.
LanguageData.IgnoreAssignmentsExplained: Allow forced work when the relevant work priority is disabled.
LanguageData.BuildingSmartTitle: Use smart building for new forced jobs
LanguageData.BuildingSmartExplained: Use the safer build order by default for new forced jobs.
LanguageData.WorkMarkersExplained: Show small markers on forced-work targets.
LanguageData.ForceCommandsEnabledExplained: Show a lightning button on ordinary right-click jobs. It starts forced work and can add nearby matching targets.
LanguageData.MaxForcedItemsExplained: Limit how many nearby matching targets Achtung adds to one forced-work command.
LanguageData.CleanRoomDescription: Clean the entire room, not just one spot.
LanguageData.FireFightDescription: Extinguish a fire completely, even outside the home area.
LanguageData.SowZoneDescription: Sow an entire growing zone or room.
LanguageData.CouldNotFindMoreForcedWork: {0} could not find any more forced work. The remaining targets are probably reserved or unreachable.
LanguageData.WorkType_Rescue_Description: Carry downed allies to beds where they can be treated.
